items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: I played with Lionel Hampton before I played with Ray Charles... I've been with Lionel Hampton about eight times

ctx.x: that was the top place. The rhythm club was the top place?

Yeah. The rhythm club was where all the top bands would come, you know, like Count Basie and Lionel Hampton and Andy Kirk, the Sunset Royal. But that was a good band out of Florida. For those bands you used to play at the Tick Tock. Did you go to the rhythm club? Oh yeah. That was the first time I heard Louis Armstrong was at the rhythm club. Louis Armstrong came and I had to play one Sunday. And I had to hurry and buy my advance ticket. Because if you wait until that night and pay it to do it, it was a dollar.…
She wanted to save that money.
